patthana17.6:1.1: Kusalaṃ pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nakusalo napītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… pañca. (Saṃkhittaṃ.) Hetuyā terasa, ārammaṇe nava…pe… vipāke tīṇi…pe… avigate terasa.
patthana17.6:2.1: Kusalaṃ sukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nakusalo nasukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… pañca. (Saṃkhittaṃ.) Hetuyā terasa, ārammaṇe nava…pe… vipāke tīṇi…pe… avigate terasa.
patthana17.6:3.1: Kusalaṃ upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nakusalo naupekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… pañca. (Saṃkhittaṃ.) Hetuyā terasa, ārammaṇe nava…pe… vipāke tīṇi…pe… avigate terasa.
